name: Herbert Tankard
bio: A pageboy at the Savoy Hotel, named in the Marquess of Queensberry's 1895 plea of justification. Queensberry's solicitors traced him after he had moved to Calais. He was never called and gave no evidence: the allegation exists only as a clause in the plea, and nothing of his own account survives.
bio_note: Holland, The Real Trial of Oscar Wilde, Appendix A, printed 289. Holland's index entry reads 'Tankard, Herbert (Savoy pageboy), tracked down by Russell, xxiv; cited in q's plea, 289'; the introduction at PDF 28-29 describes Russell's agents reaching 'a pageboy from the Savoy who had since moved to Calais'. Dates: none recorded; no age is stated, and none is inferred.
